purpose: Check whether all three model aliases can emit executable exact-text edits without asking them to calculate diff hunk counts. Output cap is doubled equally for all aliases. This sentinel reuses a prior feasibility case; it is not held-out calibration, a new independent benchmark sample or an allocation comparison.
rule: One call per alias, no automatic retries or manual source repairs. Empty/non-stop/schema/apply/visible/regression failures are separate. Same frozen images, source allowlist and tests. Do not escalate to a full batch until every sentinel outcome has been audited. Previous v1 and offline decoder outcomes remain unchanged.
